title: Micron progressed SOCAMM2, MRDIMM and server-memory products
canonical_summary: Micron described continued progress on HBM-adjacent server-memory products, including SOCAMM2 capacity and MRDIMM and next-generation server-memory development.
known_event_summary: September 2-3, 2026 Micron server-memory milestones: SOCAMM2 was described at up to 2 TB per CPU platform while MRDIMM and next-generation server memory remained on track.

facts.proposition: Development of MRDIMM and next-generation server memory remains on track.
Micron Technology is advancing high-performance data-center memory products, including HBM4, DDR5, and LPDRAM-based SOCAMM2.
Micron's SOCAMM2 provides up to 2 terabytes of memory per CPU platform.
